# Can accession neighbours recover a later Minneapolis catalogue declaration?

This independent institution tests whether a method designed on the Metropolitan Museum of Art catalogue can be refitted with Minneapolis records. The prediction target is the literal string `Public Domain` versus every other explicit nonblank string in Minneapolis's `rights_type` field. Whitespace is trimmed. A blank or absent string supplies no target. The museum also publishes a separate image-access variable named `restricted`. Image-access flags, copyright strings, image fields, gallery, editorial flags and rights text are excluded as predictors. These declarations describe catalogue data quality. The museum publishes the metadata under CC0 and addresses use of photographs separately. [Collection and identifier definitions](https://github.com/artsmia/collection/blob/790eb625934680f2eeccb262391618d2ca948486/readme.md) · [Metadata licence](https://github.com/artsmia/collection/blob/790eb625934680f2eeccb262391618d2ca948486/LICENSE)

## Evaluation units and partitions

Use the final catalogue snapshot of 2024 and the release dated 21 January 2026. Consider object records present at the earlier date. Extract the numeric ID from the archive path. Exclude IDs 1 and 17, which were viewed during source discovery. Parse no object body in the training-feasibility audit unless its ID falls in buckets 0–59. Define the bucket by the first 12 hexadecimal digits of SHA-256 of the decimal ID encoded as UTF-8, modulo 100. IDs in 60–79 are for development and 80–99 for a one-time final evaluation. Audit splits by ID before opening any corresponding JSON document. The archive checksum covers the bytes of all documents.

1. **Primary natural-missingness question.** An earlier object row has a blank or absent rights declaration. Predict the later declaration only when the later release explicitly fills the field. Use earlier metadata and the earlier records' observed declarations. Fit/tune the rules using training/development IDs exclusively. Freeze the candidate, hyperparameters, metadata normalization and baseline list before examining reserved outcomes. Historical fills can arise from upstream export changes; the releases establish a missing field and its later contents, without establishing the editor's intent. The endpoint concerns subsequently filled fields only. Report the number of eligible records without an observable subsequent label.
2. **Secondary controlled masking.** In the earlier snapshot, hide every development/test declaration and use only training declarations. Predict the earlier label on records that have one. This covers a different missingness regime. Do not pool errors from the two endpoints. Report strata for family support and a sensitivity analysis masking entire families.

Use string department, class, object name, normalized artist, recorded artwork date and accession number. Admit a family key only for accession strings with three or more nonempty dot-separated components, after dropping the final component. Two-component accession numbers often consist of a year and item number, so taking their first segment would incorrectly make the year an accession family. Treat the grouping as a syntactic proxy. Report its observed coverage and label heterogeneity. Artist strings are names/credits here, unlike the Met's constituent IDs. An algorithm that refits at each museum measures transfer of a procedure. It does not test transfer of Met-trained model weights.

## Baselines and inference

Use the matched family-average, global and field-only predictors, ordered CatBoost, pooled CatBoost, the original Met neighbourhood method, and the strongest change proposed on Met with its matched ablations. Add relation-aware weakly supervised HoloClean with only written constraints shared across splits, and the random-forest categorical imputation used by missForest. Use comparable probabilities for log loss. Where a published implementation supplies a hard prediction only, retain its native classification result and distinguish any probability-producing adaptation. HoloClean already uses value co-occurrence and integrity constraints. Missing categorical cell prediction with observable neighbours alone establishes little novelty. [HoloClean, PVLDB](https://doi.org/10.14778/3137628.3137631) · [HoloClean implementation](https://github.com/HoloClean/holoclean) · [MissForest, Bioinformatics](https://doi.org/10.1093/bioinformatics/btr597) · [CatBoost, NeurIPS](https://proceedings.neurips.cc/paper/2018/hash/14491b756b3a51daac41c24863285549-Abstract.html)

Measure mean object log loss and paired differences, clustering by syntactic accession family and treating each ungrouped object as its own cluster. Report largest-cluster influence, cluster count, class counts and unseen-family coverage. Require a gain of 0.005 nats over each strong comparator, a positive simultaneous lower confidence bound and multiplicity-adjusted paired tests against the practical margin. A natural-fill cohort with a missing outcome class or too few independent clusters cannot establish this claim. Keep development and test unopened when training already rules out useful evaluation. This local protocol precedes the training audit but has no external timestamp.
